name: TIC TIMOR Electronic Government Data Center
developer: TIC TIMOR (Agência da Tecnologia Informação e Comunicação), Government of Timor-Leste
notes: TIC TIMOR official Data Center role page (verified live 2026-08-12) and 2024 ADB coordination article name a Data Center Directorate managing the Electronic Government Data Center in Dili (Caicoli/MTC area). Government data-center function; physical specs, rack count and electrical load not public - capacity_mw null per methodology. Negative baseline re-checked 2026-08-12: no AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI region for Timor-Leste on official provider region lists (nearest practical regions Singapore/Jakarta/Sydney).

name: Prime Minister's Office Data Center
notes: Official government release (2018, p=19673) says 12 municipal administrations are being connected through EDTL substations into the Prime Minister's Office Data Center via a government private fiber network contract. Confirmed government DC anchor in Dili; no public MW/specs.

name: Ministry of Finance Data Center
developer: Ministry of Finance, Timor-Leste (vendors incl. VISIMITRA UNIPESSOAL LDA, BANNILA UNIPESSOAL LDA)
notes: CNA TENDER/13/MOF-2024 post-qualification plus eProcurement records prove an existing MoF data center repeatedly upgraded: 1219650 (ICT equipment for MdF Data Centre, 2023-06-21, USD 884,375 awarded VISIMITRA), 979880 (hard disk/RAM upgrade, 2021-11-17, USD 191,780 awarded BANNILA), 1133403 (Data Center Recovery, ICB/063/MOF-2022). Procurement amounts are proxies only; physical room and MW not disclosed - capacity_mw null.

name: Telkomcel Data Center Building
notes: Operator/parent (Telin) official pages confirm the first Telkomcel Data Center Building in Timor-Leste (Dili, Timor Plaza business area) and a data-center/ERP service page; Telin global profile lists Timor-Leste among its carrier-neutral data center markets (Tier II-IV). Physical address/specs and MW not publicly disclosed - verify directly with Telkomcel before any capacity claim; capacity_mw null. Note: PT NTT Indonesia Technology in MoF tenders is a vendor, not NTT Global Data Centers.

name: National Data Center and Disaster Recovery Facilities (ADB 55338-001 e-Government Development and Infrastructure Project)
developer: Government of Timor-Leste (executing agency: Council for Administration of the Infrastructure Fund); ADB OCR loan USD 50m
notes: ADB project page (verified live 2026-08-12) and PDS mirror show status Proposed with outputs including 'National data center and disaster recovery facilities established'. Likely Dili primary plus DR site TBD (Baucau is a search hypothesis only, no official site naming found this pass). Not under construction; watch ADB RRP/business opportunities and TIC TIMOR/CNA/eProcurement for progression.

name: TL-IXP (ANC-led national Internet Exchange)
developer: Autoridade Nacional de Comunicações (ANC) with technical adviser support
notes: ANC technical-adviser TOR (Aug 2025) covers route server, IXP Manager, DNS, virtualization and infrastructure setup for a national IXP, Dili likely. Interconnection anchor, not a colocation facility by itself; listed for completeness of the Dili connectivity/DC ecosystem.

name: TLSSC Bebonuk Cable Landing Station (Timor-Leste South Submarine Cable System)
developer: Cabos de Timor-Leste (CTL, state-owned); cable by Alcatel Submarine Networks; Dili landing station by DXN
notes: TLSSC (607 km, 27 Tbps) landed at Bebonuk, Dili in June 2024 and was commercially launched by CTL in 2026 (Developing Telecoms/DCD). Recorded as connectivity anchor per methodology: cable capacity (27 Tbps) is NOT datacenter IT load; not a commercial colo unless colocation/service evidence appears. DXN built the Dili landing station (deal ~USD 1.4m per DCD).

name: Timor Telecom core/backbone (Telecom Building, Caicoli)
notes: Timor Telecom is the main fixed/mobile/backbone operator and hosts ANC at the Telecom Building, Avenida Xavier do Amaral No. 8, Caicoli, Dili. Operator identity is A; no public named data-center/server-room colo product found this pass, so recorded as telecom core/backbone (network infrastructure), not a commercial DC. Capacity null.

name: Telemor / Viettel Timor-Leste core network rooms
notes: Telemor official site confirms operator presence (Dili, Timor Plaza area) and nationwide network. No facility-level data-center evidence found this pass (searches for 'Telemor/Viettel Timor data center server' returned no named DC); recorded as telecom core network only, per methodology A-for-identity/C-for-DC rule.

name: Vanov Technology data center services
notes: Local ICT vendor (Dili Aituri-Laran/Taibesi; eProcurement vendor record also lists Farol/Dili) with a data-center consultant/services page and government procurement awards (A-grade vendor record). Public colocation facility address/capacity not confirmed - service lead only; capacity_mw null, status unknown rather than operational.

name: Zchwantech sovereign AI cloud and data centre (partnership/feasibility)
developer: Zchwantech Sdn Bhd (Malaysia) with Government of Timor-Leste
notes: The Star (2025-12-31), NST and Zchwantech blog report a landmark partnership (announced Dec 2025) for a national sovereign AI cloud and data centre to Tier 3+ standards, aligned with Timor Digital 2032; described as co-development/feasibility stage. No official timor-leste.gov.tl page or procurement confirmation found this pass - keep B/announced until gov.tl or CNA/eProcurement confirmation; site TBD (Dili likely).

name: Atal Networks 'Tier III Dili' claim
notes: Directory/SEO-style hosting page claiming a Tier III Dili facility. No physical address or operator corroboration found this pass; per methodology this is a C-grade lead only and is NOT counted as a verified facility. Capacity null.
